comment: Start, end, layer change, filament change, pause and time lapse G-code (filament start and end G-code ship with the filament presets) per printer family. Families named maker_* are the makers' own text as OrcaSlicer 2.4.2 resolves it for the printer's default filament, used with the makers' permission; the others were written for SlicerX for printers Orca has no preset for.

klipper_macro.start:
; Wait for the bed and the hotend, then let the printer's PRINT_START macro do the rest.
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]
PRINT_START EXTRUDER=[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] BED=[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]

creality_k1.start:

T[initial_no_support_extruder]
M204 S2000 ; print acceleration
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]
G1 Z3 F600
M83 ; relative extrusion
G92 E0
G1 Z1 F600
creality_k1.changeFilament:
; Lift in a spiral, park at the back, then come back down.

G1 X0 Y{print_bed_max[1] - 5} F30000
G1 Z{z_after_toolchange} F600
